Our little corner of Lusaka

A space to
unwind and make.

Casa Luano began with a vision for a space where community could come together to be creative, unwind and enjoy a memorable experience. Art, nature, good company and good food all belong at the same table.

Wildflower Ceramics brings the clay: handmade pottery to paint and guided time on the wheel. Casa Luano brings the room to relax and make a day of it.
